name: gizza-ai/gif-to-mp4
summary: Convert an animated GIF to a smaller MP4/WebM video.

tool.description: Convert an animated GIF into a much smaller MP4 (H.264) or WebM (VP9) video, preserving the animation. Set format='mp4' (default) or 'webm'. Provide the GIF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

format.description: Output video format: mp4 (H.264, default) or webm (VP9).
